units: pixels (x right, y down, full 1920x1080 resolution) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (mean |frame-to-frame diff| on cart-free ceiling/wall regions < 0.75 grey levels for all frames; no pan/shake)
camera.view: looking straight down an underground parking-garage aisle (one-point perspective, vanishing point near x~960-1000, y~430-450); the cart drives across the foreground, side-on, perpendicular to the view axis
camera.notes: cart stays at a constant depth: wheel-ground contact y = 946-948 in all frames, body length 547-553 px and height 482-484 px once fully visible -> planar (2D) motion, one px scale applies to the cart

objects.name: cart
objects.description: light-blue small electric utility cart / golf-cart-like vehicle with a roof canopy (blue roof with orange/yellow light bar at its front edge), white/grey rear box, dark-blue seat, steering wheel, 2 visible black wheels with grey hubs, row of 3 small orange lights on the lower body between the wheels. Only moving object.
objects.direction: left -> right (+x), purely horizontal; front faces right
objects.visible_frames: 0-41 (enters from the left edge; partially out of frame at left in 0-22, fully in view 23-41; never leaves)

size_px_when_fully_visible.length_measured_frames: 31-41 (frames 23-27 give 553-570 and 28-30 give 566-597 because of floor-reflection contamination at the front)
size_px_when_fully_visible.height_note: from canopy top (y 465-467) to tyre bottom (y 947)
size_px_when_fully_visible.wheelbase_note: rear wheel centre ~582, front wheel centre ~919 at frame 30 (visual, +-4 px)
size_px_when_fully_visible.rear_canopy_tip_to_front_bumper: x0 = rear tip of canopy (top left), x1 = front lower bumper / front wheel fender

objects.reference_point_recommendation: the vehicle root is not visible; use the bbox centre ref_x (frames 23-27, 31-41 clean) or, for frame-to-frame motion, a rigid feature: panel_x (frames 18-41, sub-pixel), front_upper_x (frames 0-41, integer), bbox_x0 rear (frames 23-41). Vertical position is constant (y ~ 885 for the panel, contact line 947).
objects.ambiguity: different rigid features give per-frame x increments that differ by up to ~1 px/frame (~2%); see notes.md

events.event: cart already moving at frame 0 (front at x=32, just entering from left edge); it starts slowly (front edge +1 px between frames 0 and 1, +5 px 1->2) and speeds up
lower front bumper enters frame (front_upper_x vs bbox_x1 diverge)
cart fully inside the image (rear canopy tip x0 >= 91)
maximum frame-to-frame displacement ~50 px/frame (speed peaks, then the cart decelerates)
end of clip; cart still moving (~43 px/frame) and still fully in view

no_events: no bounce, impact, contact with other objects, or reversal of direction
